{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders — only completed orders count for conversion
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify the filter worked
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(sales) - len(completed_orders)}")

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment on completed orders only
conversion_rate = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
conversion_rate['rate'] = conversion_rate['sum'] / conversion_rate['count']

# Sort by rate descending
conversion_rate_sorted = conversion_rate.sort_values('rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate_sorted.index[0]

# Print the full conversion rate table
conversion_rate_sorted"}
